newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel- low sulphur margins hurting.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel- low sulphur margins hurting.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady, not because of any intrinsic strength rather because of an absence of activity.
"Nothing much is happening, but if I was a buyer I'd be looking for sub-$140 fob NWE and straight-run margins have been hit by weaker products," said one dealer.
Russian fuel has not yet dried up. "It's not very cold in Russia, so internal consumption is low, so they are still exporting like mad," said a dealer.
An M-40 with two pct water was heard offered at two means -$4 while an M-100 was seeking buyers around two means +$2. -- London Newsroom +44 711 542 8980 Reuter Terminal users can
